items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Jake. Jake, huh? Yeah, probably they called Jake.

ctx.x: Which instrument did he play then? Banjo or guitar or what? He played banjo. Banjo at that time. Mm-hmm. Have a clarinet player? Saxophone player? No, they had a clarinet. Handy. Yeah.

A handy from downtown. John Handy, sure. John Handy, sure. John Handy, yeah. I must have had a bass player or a piano player. Yeah, they had a bass player, I just remember. Jake. Jake, huh? Yeah, probably they called Jake. Mm-hmm.
We'll check with Handy, he probably knows him, and Tom Alvarez. Yeah, yeah. Who did George Washington play with too? George Washington? Mm-hmm. George Washington.
